WHY THESE CHANGES

A clearer path from a goal to a choice.

01

Keep goals together

Observed: Protein Grams Per Serving is already visible in the sidebar. Other nutrition groups appear farther down the inspected page.

Change: Keep shopper-selected goals together beside the count without removing the sidebar.

Test: Can shoppers locate and revisit their criteria?

02

Match precise numbers

Observed: Protein bands and Dietary Fiber (>10 g) are existing options.

Change: Use inclusive, editable minimums; selected goals combine with AND.

Try: Set a goal, compare the serving, then add an optional second criterion.

03

Compare the serving

Observed: Compare already exists and some result titles contain numeric nutrition. It is not uniform across inspected cards.

Change: Show selected nutrients in a repeatable card row and compare labeled servings or equal 100 g amounts.

Tradeoff: Per-serving relevance and equal-weight comparison answer different questions.

Scope and evidence: Regular amazon.com/s search includes separate Amazon Now and Whole Foods/Fresh shopping modules. Those modules are outside this retail concept. The fiber example appeared in regular results. Product detail includes description, product images and manufacturer comparison information. No claim is made that Amazon lacks nutrition filters, nutrition facts or Compare. Only this safe BEFORE crop was retained; further live captures timed out.

MEASURE BEFORE EXPANDING

Clearer choices.
A hypothesis to test.

Test time to a suitable result, serving-size comprehension, completed comparisons and recovery from no matches. These are proposed customer tests, not measured improvements.

Data freshness is a constraint. Missing or conflicting required values are excluded from matching, including zero-valued goals. Source facts and serving caveats stay visible. Reference fixtures are not verified live offers. No conversion lift, native-app testing or live catalog coverage is claimed.
